title: Constant-Time Planning for Chaining Collision-free Motion to Manipulation Behaviors
abstract: arXiv:2512.00939v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent progress in contact-rich robotic manipulation has been striking, yet most deployed systems remain confined to simple, scripted routines. One of the barriers is the lack of motion planning algorithms that can provide verifiable guarantees for safety, efficiency and reliability. Constant-Time Motion Planning (CTMP) is a recent step toward such guarantees for collision-free motion in a priori known environments:: a preprocessing phase enables queries to be answered within a fixed, user-specified time budget (e.g., 10 milliseconds). However, CTMP certifies only reachability---a binary predicate---and ignores the manipulation behavior that completes the task, which is increasingly stochastic (e.g., a learned skill) and whose success no single offline rollout can establish, let alone certify. We introduce the Behavioral Constant-Time Motion Planner (B-CTMP), which extends CTMP to two-step manipulation tasks in semi-structured

translated_title: 恒定时间规划：将无碰撞运动与操作行为相链接
translated_abstract: 近年来，接触密集型机器人操作技术取得了显著进展，但大多数已部署的系统仍局限于简单的脚本化流程。其中一个障碍是缺乏能够为安全性、效率和可靠性提供可验证保证的运动规划算法。恒定时间运动规划（CTMP）是朝着在先验已知环境中为无碰撞运动提供此类保证迈出的一步：通过预处理阶段，可以在固定的、用户指定的时间预算内（例如10毫秒）回答查询。然而，CTMP仅能认证可达性（一个二元谓词），而忽略了完成任务所需的操作行为。这些操作行为日益具有随机性（例如学习到的技能），其成功与否无法通过单次离线推演来确定，更谈不上认证。我们提出了行为恒定时间运动规划器（B-CTMP），它将CTMP扩展到半结构化环境中的两步操作任务……
tldr: 本文提出行为恒定时间运动规划器（B-CTMP），将恒定时间运动规划从仅认证无碰撞运动的可达性扩展到半结构化环境中的两步操作任务，从而为包含随机操作行为（如学习技能）的操作流程提供可验证的安全性与可靠性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Behavioral Constant-Time Motion Planner (B-CTMP), which extends constant-time motion planning from certifying only reachability of collision-free motion to two-step manipulation tasks in semi-structured environments, providing verifiable guarantees for workflows involving stochastic manipulation behaviors such as learned skills.
